Hi Elena — welcome!

Thanks for sending the paperwork. Quick answers:
- PO routing: send POs to ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com with the Solstice Health vendor ID in the subject line. Monica handles vendor activation and will validate the W-9 and banking details.
- Payment terms: our standard is Net30. Aditya in finance is CC'd to confirm if we can enable the early-pay discount program for Solstice.

Monica — can you pick up the onboarding packet and kick off vendor activation? If any additional documentation is needed, please loop Elena directly.

Elena — if you prefer, we can also enroll you for early-pay via DocuSign; I'll include the enrollment form once finance confirms the rate.

Thanks,

Thanks Vanessa & Elena.

Finance note: we generally offer Net30 standard terms. Early-pay (discount for payment within a shorter window) is handled case-by-case based on account velocity and revenue forecast. For smaller partners we typically offer 1.5% at Net10 or 2% at Net7 for enrollments that run through our early-pay provider — there is a short underwriting step.

Elena — if you can confirm the expected monthly spend in the first 3 months and provide your ACH details (or confirm you'd like Redwood to initiate payment by AP portal), we can route this for underwriting. I'll need a signed early-pay enrollment form to start the process. I've attached our enrollment template for convenience.

Attachment: [EarlyPay_Enrollment_Form.xlsx (Excel, 56KB)]

Regards,
